cases.name: idle-without-gesture
cases.condition: No modal gesture is open, no local pointer gesture is active, and no local preview is in flight; the OverlayLayer preview is undefined and dimmedRefs is empty unless no preview exists to generate callout refs.
cases.outcome: It passes an undefined preview to OverlayLayer and returns no dimmed refs unless an active preview supplies callout annotation refs.

cases.name: local-pointer-move-preview
cases.condition: No modal gesture is open and a local pointer move gesture is active with a local preview; the local preview is passed through to OverlayLayer and the moving refs are dimmed.
cases.outcome: It passes the local move preview through to OverlayLayer and dims all moving refs, plus any callout refs from that preview.
cases.domain: any active local move gesture and its preview

cases.name: local-pointer-resize-preview
cases.condition: No modal gesture is open and a local pointer resize gesture is active with a local preview; the local preview is passed through to OverlayLayer and the resized ref is dimmed.
cases.outcome: It passes the local resize preview through to OverlayLayer and dims the resized ref, plus any callout refs from that preview.
cases.domain: any active local resize gesture and its preview

cases.name: modal-grab-with-preview
cases.condition: A modal grab gesture is open, geometry is defined, and modalPreview returns a preview; that modal preview is passed to OverlayLayer and every ref in the modal gesture is included in dimmedRefs.
cases.outcome: It passes the modal grab preview to OverlayLayer and dims every ref in the modal gesture.
cases.domain: any modal grab gesture with any non-empty or empty refs array

cases.name: modal-resize-with-preview
cases.condition: A modal resize gesture is open, geometry is defined, and modalPreview returns a preview; that modal preview is passed to OverlayLayer and only the first modal ref is included in dimmedRefs.
cases.outcome: It passes the modal resize preview to OverlayLayer and dims only the modal gesture's first ref.
cases.domain: any modal resize gesture whose refs array contains its single target ref

cases.name: modal-gesture-without-geometry
cases.condition: A modal gesture is open while geometry() is undefined; the modal preview is undefined because the geometry guard applies to the modal branch, while dimmedRefs still uses the modal grab refs or first modal resize ref.
cases.outcome: It passes an undefined preview while still dimming all modal grab refs or the first modal resize ref.
cases.domain: any open modal gesture with unavailable scene geometry

cases.name: modal-preview-undefined
cases.condition: A modal gesture is open, geometry is defined, and modalPreview returns undefined; OverlayLayer receives an undefined preview, while dimmedRefs still contains the modal grab refs or first modal resize ref.
cases.outcome: It passes an undefined preview while still dimming all modal grab refs or the first modal resize ref.
cases.domain: any modal gesture for which modalPreview returns undefined

cases.name: modal-precedence-over-local-state
cases.condition: A modal gesture is open at the same time that local gesture() or local preview() has a value; both memos use the modal gesture as the higher-precedence source, so local preview and local moving/resizing refs are ignored for these props.
cases.outcome: It uses the modal gesture's preview and target refs for both props, ignoring local preview and local gesture state.
cases.domain: any combination of an open modal gesture and local pointer gesture state

cases.name: modal-grab-callout-dimming
cases.condition: A modal grab gesture produces a preview whose bounds yield callout previews; the modal target refs are retained and any corresponding annotation refs are appended without duplicates.
cases.outcome: It retains every modal grab ref and appends each corresponding callout annotation ref once.
cases.domain: any modal grab preview with zero or more callout preview annotations

cases.name: modal-resize-callout-dimming
cases.condition: A modal resize gesture produces a preview whose bounds yield callout previews; the single modal resize target ref is retained and any corresponding annotation refs are appended without duplicates.
cases.outcome: It retains the single modal resize target ref and appends each corresponding callout annotation ref once.
cases.domain: any modal resize preview with zero or more callout preview annotations

cases.name: pointer-down-clears-modal
cases.condition: A pointer-down event occurs while a modal gesture is open; Canvas clears the modal gesture before routing the press, preventing the modal and pointer interaction from being live together, after which normal pointer-down behavior proceeds.
cases.outcome: It clears the modal gesture before routing the pointer press, so the normal pointer interaction proceeds alone.
cases.domain: any pointer-down event while a modal gesture is defined

cases.name: pointer-down-without-modal
cases.condition: A pointer-down event occurs with no modal gesture open; no modal state needs clearing and the existing pointer interaction routing proceeds unchanged.
cases.outcome: It leaves modal state unchanged and performs the existing pointer interaction routing.
cases.domain: any pointer-down event while the modal gesture is undefined

cases.name: double-click-annotation
cases.condition: A pointer-down event is the second click on an annotation; after modal state is cleared, Canvas enters text editing for that annotation and does not start a pointer gesture.
cases.outcome: It clears the modal gesture, selects the annotation, enters text editing, and starts no pointer gesture.
cases.domain: any second click whose hit target is an annotation

cases.name: modal-enter-resize-target
cases.condition: A modal enter-resize gesture is open; its single target ref is treated like the resize case for dimming, because enter-resize only opens for a single selected element.
cases.outcome: It dims the modal enter-resize gesture's sole target ref as the resize case does.
cases.domain: a single selected element

cases.name: enter-grab-non-empty-selection
cases.condition: Running the enter-grab command with a non-empty selection opens a grab modal gesture for the current selection.
cases.outcome: Running enter-grab with a non-empty selection opens a grab modal gesture for the current selection.
cases.domain: any non-empty selection

cases.name: enter-grab-empty-selection
cases.condition: Running enter-grab with an empty selection does nothing: no gesture opens, the mode indicator stays dark, and Escape remains the selection-clearing command.
cases.outcome: Running enter-grab with an empty selection does nothing, leaving no gesture open, the mode indicator dark, and Escape as the selection-clearing command.

cases.name: enter-resize-single-selection
cases.condition: Running the enter-resize command with exactly one selected element opens a resize modal gesture for that element.
cases.outcome: Running enter-resize with exactly one selected element opens a resize modal gesture for that element.

cases.name: enter-resize-empty-selection
cases.condition: Running enter-resize with an empty selection does nothing and opens no gesture.
cases.outcome: Running enter-resize with an empty selection does nothing and opens no gesture.

cases.name: enter-resize-multiple-selection
cases.condition: Running enter-resize with a selection containing two or more elements does nothing and opens no gesture, because resize is single-element only.
cases.outcome: Running enter-resize with two or more selected elements does nothing and opens no gesture because resize is single-element only.
cases.domain: any selection containing at least two elements

cases.name: dispatch-with-open-gesture
cases.condition: Dispatching either added command through runCommand while a gesture is open first clears the existing gesture; the command then either opens a new gesture when its selection precondition is satisfied or does nothing when it is not.
cases.outcome: Dispatching either added command through runCommand first clears any open gesture, then opens the appropriate gesture when its selection precondition is met or does nothing otherwise.
cases.domain: an open gesture combined with any selection state

cases.name: known-command-with-open-modal-gesture
cases.condition: The id matches a registered command and context.ui currently has an open modal gesture; the gesture is cleared before the command runs.
cases.outcome: Clear the open modal gesture, then run the matching command.
cases.domain: any registered command id and any open modal gesture

cases.name: known-command-without-open-modal-gesture
cases.condition: The id matches a registered command and no modal gesture is open; the unconditional clear is effectively a no-op, then the command runs.
cases.outcome: Perform the unconditional no-op clear, then run the matching command.
cases.domain: any registered command id and an undefined modal gesture

cases.name: gesture-opening-command
cases.condition: The id is the enter-grab or enter-resize command; the existing gesture is cleared first, and the command then opens its new gesture.
cases.outcome: Clear any existing gesture first, then run the enter-grab or enter-resize command so it opens the new gesture.
cases.domain: one of: enter-grab, enter-resize

cases.name: unknown-command-with-open-modal-gesture
cases.condition: The id does not match any registered command and a modal gesture is open; the gesture is cleared, then the function silently returns without running a command.
cases.outcome: Clear the open modal gesture, then silently return without running a command.
cases.domain: any unregistered command id and any open modal gesture

cases.name: unknown-command-without-open-modal-gesture
cases.condition: The id does not match any registered command and no modal gesture is open; the clear is effectively a no-op, and the function silently returns.
cases.outcome: Perform the unconditional no-op clear, then silently return without running a command.
cases.domain: any unregistered command id and an undefined modal gesture

cases.name: ignored-editable-target
cases.condition: The event target is an input, textarea, or contenteditable element, so shouldIgnoreKey returns true; the function returns false without consulting modal or chord handling.
cases.outcome: It returns false immediately without consulting the modal gesture or chord handling.
cases.domain: any event whose target is a text-editing element

cases.name: no-modal-unmatched-chord
cases.condition: The event target is not ignored, no modal gesture is open, and resolveChord finds no command for the event key and modifiers; the function returns false.
cases.outcome: It returns false because no chord command matches.
cases.domain: any non-editing event with an unmapped key/modifier combination

cases.name: no-modal-matched-chord
cases.condition: The event target is not ignored, no modal gesture is open, and resolveChord finds a command; runCommand is called and the function returns true.
cases.outcome: It runs the matched command and returns true.
cases.domain: any non-editing event with a mapped key/modifier combination

cases.name: modal-continue
cases.condition: A modal gesture is open and modalKeyDown(gesture, event.key) returns 'continue'; ui.setModalGesture is called with step.gesture and the function returns true, including when the step only edits the digit buffer.
cases.outcome: It sets the modal gesture to step.gesture and returns true, including when only the digit buffer was edited.
cases.domain: any modal key outcome classified as 'continue'

cases.name: modal-commit
cases.condition: A modal gesture is open and modalKeyDown(gesture, event.key) returns 'commit'; commitModalGesture is called with the gesture read by this function, the modal gesture is cleared with ui.setModalGesture(undefined), and the function returns true.
cases.outcome: It commits the read gesture, clears the modal gesture, and returns true.
cases.domain: any modal key outcome classified as 'commit'

cases.name: modal-cancel
cases.condition: A modal gesture is open and modalKeyDown(gesture, event.key) returns 'cancel'; the modal gesture is cleared with ui.setModalGesture(undefined) and the function returns true.
cases.outcome: It clears the modal gesture and returns true.
cases.domain: any modal key outcome classified as 'cancel'

cases.name: modal-ignore-unmatched-chord
cases.condition: A modal gesture is open and modalKeyDown(gesture, event.key) returns 'ignore'; handling falls through to the chord path, resolveChord finds no command, and the function returns false.
cases.outcome: It falls through to chord handling, finds no command, and returns false.
cases.domain: any modal key classified as 'ignore' with an unmapped key/modifier combination

cases.name: modal-ignore-matched-chord
cases.condition: A modal gesture is open and modalKeyDown(gesture, event.key) returns 'ignore'; handling falls through to the chord path, resolveChord finds a command, runCommand is called, and the function returns true.
cases.outcome: It falls through to chord handling, runs the matched command, and returns true.
cases.domain: any modal key classified as 'ignore' with a mapped key/modifier combination

cases.name: undefined-direction
cases.condition: The gesture direction is undefined; the function returns the zero vector regardless of the stored distance digits.
cases.outcome: Returns the zero vector regardless of the stored distance digits.
cases.domain: any allowed digits value, including the empty string and any 1-to-6-character decimal digit string

cases.name: up-empty-distance
cases.condition: The direction is 'up' and the distance digits are empty; magnitude is 0 and the result is { x: 0, y: 0 }.
cases.outcome: Returns { x: 0, y: 0 } because the empty distance has magnitude 0.

cases.name: up-typed-distance
cases.condition: The direction is 'up' and the distance digits are non-empty; the result is { x: 0, y: -magnitude }, where magnitude is the base-10 integer represented by the digits.
cases.outcome: Returns { x: 0, y: -magnitude }, using the base-10 integer represented by the digits.
cases.domain: any non-empty decimal digit string of length 1 through 6, representing a magnitude from 0 through 999999

cases.name: down-empty-distance
cases.condition: The direction is 'down' and the distance digits are empty; magnitude is 0 and the result is { x: 0, y: 0 }.
cases.outcome: Returns { x: 0, y: 0 } because the empty distance has magnitude 0.

cases.name: down-typed-distance
cases.condition: The direction is 'down' and the distance digits are non-empty; the result is { x: 0, y: magnitude }, where magnitude is the base-10 integer represented by the digits.
cases.outcome: Returns { x: 0, y: magnitude }, using the base-10 integer represented by the digits.
cases.domain: any non-empty decimal digit string of length 1 through 6, representing a magnitude from 0 through 999999

cases.name: left-empty-distance
cases.condition: The direction is 'left' and the distance digits are empty; magnitude is 0 and the result is { x: 0, y: 0 }.
cases.outcome: Returns { x: 0, y: 0 } because the empty distance has magnitude 0.

cases.name: left-typed-distance
cases.condition: The direction is 'left' and the distance digits are non-empty; the result is { x: -magnitude, y: 0 }, where magnitude is the base-10 integer represented by the digits.
cases.outcome: Returns { x: -magnitude, y: 0 }, using the base-10 integer represented by the digits.
cases.domain: any non-empty decimal digit string of length 1 through 6, representing a magnitude from 0 through 999999

cases.name: right-empty-distance
cases.condition: The direction is 'right' and the distance digits are empty; magnitude is 0 and the result is { x: 0, y: 0 }.
cases.outcome: Returns { x: 0, y: 0 } because the empty distance has magnitude 0.

cases.name: right-typed-distance
cases.condition: The direction is 'right' and the distance digits are non-empty; the result is { x: magnitude, y: 0 }, where magnitude is the base-10 integer represented by the digits.
cases.outcome: Returns { x: magnitude, y: 0 }, using the base-10 integer represented by the digits.
cases.domain: any non-empty decimal digit string of length 1 through 6, representing a magnitude from 0 through 999999

cases.name: up-direction
cases.condition: The gesture direction is 'up'; the function returns the north edge handle 'n'.
cases.outcome: returns the north edge handle 'n' for an 'up' direction
cases.domain: gestures whose direction is 'up'

cases.name: down-direction
cases.condition: The gesture direction is 'down'; the function returns the south edge handle 's'.
cases.outcome: returns the south edge handle 's' for a 'down' direction
cases.domain: gestures whose direction is 'down'

cases.name: left-direction
cases.condition: The gesture direction is 'left'; the function returns the west edge handle 'w'.
cases.outcome: returns the west edge handle 'w' for a 'left' direction
cases.domain: gestures whose direction is 'left'

cases.name: right-direction
cases.condition: The gesture direction is 'right'; the function returns the east edge handle 'e'.
cases.outcome: returns the east edge handle 'e' for a 'right' direction
cases.domain: gestures whose direction is 'right'

cases.name: undefined-direction
cases.condition: The gesture direction is undefined; the function returns undefined.
cases.outcome: returns undefined when the direction is undefined

cases.name: missing-geometry
cases.condition: context.geometry is undefined; the function returns without applying any edit.
cases.outcome: Returns without applying any edit.

cases.name: empty-refs
cases.condition: The gesture has an empty refs collection; the function returns without applying any edit.
cases.outcome: Returns without applying any edit.

cases.name: resize-missing-handle
cases.condition: The gesture kind is 'resize' and modalHandle() is undefined; the function returns without applying any edit.
cases.outcome: Returns without applying any edit.

cases.name: resize-multiple-refs
cases.condition: The gesture kind is 'resize' and the gesture has more than one ref; the function returns without applying any edit.
cases.outcome: Returns without applying any edit.
cases.domain: any resize gesture with at least two refs

cases.name: move-zero-delta
cases.condition: A valid move gesture produces a zero delta; moveCommit returns undefined, so applyStyleEdit is not called.
cases.outcome: Does not call applyStyleEdit.

cases.name: resize-zero-delta
cases.condition: A valid resize gesture produces a zero delta; resizeCommit returns undefined, so applyStyleEdit is not called.
cases.outcome: Does not call applyStyleEdit.

cases.name: move-nonzero-delta
cases.condition: A move gesture passes the guards and produces a nonzero delta; the function calls applyStyleEdit exactly once with the committed edit and no coalesce key.
cases.outcome: Calls applyStyleEdit exactly once with the committed edit and no coalesce key.
cases.domain: any valid move gesture with a nonzero delta

cases.name: resize-nonzero-delta
cases.condition: A resize gesture passes the guards, has exactly one ref and a defined modal handle, and produces a nonzero delta; the function calls applyStyleEdit exactly once with the committed edit and no coalesce key.
cases.outcome: Calls applyStyleEdit exactly once with the committed edit and no coalesce key.
cases.domain: any valid resize gesture with exactly one ref and a nonzero delta

cases.name: empty-refs
cases.condition: The gesture has no refs; modalPreview returns undefined.
cases.outcome: It returns undefined when the gesture has no refs.
cases.domain: an empty refs array

cases.name: resize-multiple-refs
cases.condition: The gesture kind is 'resize' and refs contains more than one element; modalPreview returns undefined as a defensive guard.
cases.outcome: It returns undefined as a defensive guard when a resize gesture has more than one ref.
cases.domain: any resize refs array with at least two elements

cases.name: resize-missing-handle
cases.condition: The gesture kind is 'resize', refs contains exactly one element, and modalHandle(gesture) returns undefined; modalPreview returns undefined.
cases.outcome: It returns undefined when a single-ref resize gesture has no modal handle.
cases.domain: any resize gesture whose modal handle is undefined

cases.name: grab-preview
cases.condition: The gesture kind is 'grab' and refs is non-empty; modalPreview returns the moveUpdate-based preview using the delta from modalDelta(gesture).
cases.outcome: It returns the moveUpdate-based preview for a non-empty grab gesture using modalDelta(gesture).
cases.domain: any grab gesture with one or more refs

cases.name: resize-preview
cases.condition: The gesture kind is 'resize', refs contains exactly one element, and modalHandle(gesture) returns a handle; modalPreview returns the resizeUpdate-based preview with keepAspect false.
cases.outcome: It returns the resizeUpdate-based preview for a single-ref resize gesture using the modal handle and keepAspect false.
cases.domain: any resize gesture with exactly one ref and a defined modal handle

cases.name: zero-delta-preview
cases.condition: A valid open grab or resize gesture has a zero delta from modalDelta(gesture); modalPreview still returns a preview of the selection unmoved rather than undefined.
cases.outcome: It still returns an unmoved preview for a valid grab or resize gesture whose modal delta is zero.
cases.domain: any valid grab or single-ref resize gesture with zero modal delta

cases.name: modal-grab-empty-digits
cases.condition: A modal gesture is defined with kind 'grab' and digits is the empty string; the accessor returns 'Grab', regardless of the active tool.
cases.outcome: It returns 'Grab', regardless of the active tool.

cases.name: modal-grab-with-digits
cases.condition: A modal gesture is defined with kind 'grab' and digits is non-empty; the accessor returns 'Grab ' followed by the digits, regardless of the active tool.
cases.outcome: It returns 'Grab ' followed by the digits, regardless of the active tool.
cases.domain: any non-empty digit string

cases.name: modal-resize-empty-digits
cases.condition: A modal gesture is defined with kind 'resize' and digits is the empty string; the accessor returns 'Resize', regardless of the active tool.
cases.outcome: It returns 'Resize', regardless of the active tool.

cases.name: modal-resize-with-digits
cases.condition: A modal gesture is defined with kind 'resize' and digits is non-empty; the accessor returns 'Resize ' followed by the digits, regardless of the active tool.
cases.outcome: It returns 'Resize ' followed by the digits, regardless of the active tool.
cases.domain: any non-empty digit string

cases.name: no-modal-select-tool
cases.condition: No modal gesture is defined and the active tool is 'select'; the accessor returns undefined.
cases.outcome: It returns undefined.

cases.name: no-modal-hand-tool
cases.condition: No modal gesture is defined and the active tool is 'hand'; the accessor returns the label of the 'tool-hand' command.
cases.outcome: It returns the label of the 'tool-hand' command.

cases.name: no-modal-other-tool
cases.condition: No modal gesture is defined and the active tool is a non-'select', non-'hand' tool; the accessor returns the label of the 'tool-annotation' command.
cases.outcome: It returns the label of the 'tool-annotation' command.
cases.domain: any supported non-select, non-hand tool

cases.name: enter-grab-excluded
cases.condition: The command id is 'enter-grab'; it is excluded from the palette.
cases.outcome: The function should include 'enter-grab' in the excluded command set.

cases.name: enter-resize-excluded
cases.condition: The command id is 'enter-resize'; it is excluded from the palette.
cases.outcome: The function should include 'enter-resize' in the excluded command set.

cases.name: existing-members-remain-excluded
cases.condition: The command id is one of the previously excluded members: 'escape', 'nudge-up', 'nudge-down', 'nudge-left', 'nudge-right', 'ring-next', 'ring-prev', 'open-palette', or 'open-help'. It remains excluded from the palette.
cases.outcome: The function should continue to include all nine previously excluded command ids in the excluded command set.
cases.domain: one of: escape, nudge-up, nudge-down, nudge-left, nudge-right, ring-next, ring-prev, open-palette, open-help

cases.name: meta-z-undo
cases.condition: The chord is Meta+z, with no gesture open; it resolves to the undo command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Meta+z resolves to undo.

cases.name: meta-shift-z-redo
cases.condition: The chord is Meta+Shift+z, with no gesture open; it resolves to the redo command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Meta+Shift+z resolves to redo.

cases.name: backspace-delete
cases.condition: The chord is Backspace with no gesture open; it resolves to the delete command, whereas an open gesture consumes Backspace to remove a typed digit instead of resolving this entry.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Backspace resolves to delete; during an open gesture, it removes a typed digit instead.

cases.name: delete-delete
cases.condition: The chord is Delete with no gesture open; it resolves to the delete command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Delete resolves to delete.

cases.name: escape-command
cases.condition: The chord is Escape with no gesture open; it resolves to the escape command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Escape resolves to escape.

cases.name: meta-a-select-all
cases.condition: The chord is Meta+a, with no gesture open; it resolves to the select-all command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Meta+a resolves to select-all.

cases.name: arrow-up-nudge
cases.condition: The chord is ArrowUp with no gesture open; it resolves to the nudge-up command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, ArrowUp resolves to nudge-up.

cases.name: arrow-down-nudge
cases.condition: The chord is ArrowDown with no gesture open; it resolves to the nudge-down command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, ArrowDown resolves to nudge-down.

cases.name: arrow-left-nudge
cases.condition: The chord is ArrowLeft with no gesture open; it resolves to the nudge-left command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, ArrowLeft resolves to nudge-left.

cases.name: arrow-right-nudge
cases.condition: The chord is ArrowRight with no gesture open; it resolves to the nudge-right command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, ArrowRight resolves to nudge-right.

cases.name: s-ring-next
cases.condition: The bare s chord with no gesture open resolves to the ring-next command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare s resolves to ring-next.

cases.name: shift-s-ring-prev
cases.condition: The Shift+s chord with no gesture open resolves to the ring-prev command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Shift+s resolves to ring-prev.

cases.name: meta-s-save
cases.condition: The Meta+s chord with no gesture open resolves to the save command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Meta+s resolves to save.

cases.name: meta-i-focus-inspector
cases.condition: The chord is Meta+i, with no gesture open; it resolves to the focus-inspector command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Meta+i resolves to focus-inspector.

cases.name: v-tool-select
cases.condition: The bare v chord with no gesture open resolves to the tool-select command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare v resolves to tool-select.

cases.name: h-tool-hand
cases.condition: The bare h chord with no gesture open resolves to the tool-hand command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare h resolves to tool-hand.

cases.name: t-tool-annotation
cases.condition: The bare t chord with no gesture open resolves to the tool-annotation command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare t resolves to tool-annotation.

cases.name: n-add-annotation
cases.condition: The bare n chord with no gesture open resolves to the add-annotation command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare n resolves to add-annotation.

cases.name: g-enter-grab
cases.condition: The bare g chord with no gesture open resolves to the enter-grab command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare g resolves to enter-grab.

cases.name: r-enter-resize
cases.condition: The bare r chord with no gesture open resolves to the enter-resize command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare r resolves to enter-resize.

cases.name: equals-zoom-in
cases.condition: The bare = chord with no gesture open resolves to the zoom-in command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare = resolves to zoom-in.

cases.name: minus-zoom-out
cases.condition: The bare - chord with no gesture open resolves to the zoom-out command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare - resolves to zoom-out.

cases.name: zero-zoom-reset
cases.condition: The bare 0 chord with no gesture open resolves to the zoom-reset command; an open gesture consumes this digit instead of resolving the entry.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare 0 resolves to zoom-reset; during an open gesture, it is consumed as a digit instead.

cases.name: one-zoom-fit
cases.condition: The bare 1 chord with no gesture open resolves to the zoom-fit command; an open gesture consumes this digit instead of resolving the entry.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, bare 1 resolves to zoom-fit; during an open gesture, it is consumed as a digit instead.

cases.name: enter-edit-text
cases.condition: The Enter chord with no gesture open resolves to the edit-text command; an open gesture consumes Enter instead of resolving the entry.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Enter resolves to edit-text; during an open gesture, it is consumed instead.

cases.name: meta-d-duplicate
cases.condition: The chord is Meta+d, with no gesture open; it resolves to the duplicate command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Meta+d resolves to duplicate.

cases.name: meta-k-open-palette
cases.condition: The chord is Meta+k, with no gesture open; it resolves to the open-palette command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Meta+k resolves to open-palette.

cases.name: shift-question-open-help
cases.condition: The Shift+? chord with no gesture open resolves to the open-help command.
cases.outcome: With no gesture open, Shift+? resolves to open-help.

cases.name: grab-gesture
cases.condition: The gesture kind is 'grab' and refs is an array of ElementRef values; the gesture opens with direction undefined and digits empty.
cases.outcome: It should open a grab gesture with direction undefined and digits empty.
cases.domain: any array of ElementRef values

cases.name: resize-gesture
cases.condition: The gesture kind is 'resize' and refs is an array of ElementRef values; the gesture opens with direction undefined and digits empty.
cases.outcome: It should open a resize gesture with direction undefined and digits empty.
cases.domain: any array of ElementRef values

cases.name: arrow-up
cases.condition: The key is ArrowUp; the function continues with direction set to up, overwriting any prior direction and carrying digits unchanged.
cases.outcome: Continues with direction set to up, overwriting any prior direction and carrying digits unchanged.

cases.name: arrow-down
cases.condition: The key is ArrowDown; the function continues with direction set to down, overwriting any prior direction and carrying digits unchanged.
cases.outcome: Continues with direction set to down, overwriting any prior direction and carrying digits unchanged.

cases.name: arrow-left
cases.condition: The key is ArrowLeft; the function continues with direction set to left, overwriting any prior direction and carrying digits unchanged.
cases.outcome: Continues with direction set to left, overwriting any prior direction and carrying digits unchanged.

cases.name: arrow-right
cases.condition: The key is ArrowRight; the function continues with direction set to right, overwriting any prior direction and carrying digits unchanged.
cases.outcome: Continues with direction set to right, overwriting any prior direction and carrying digits unchanged.

cases.name: digit-under-cap
cases.condition: The key is a decimal digit and the gesture's digits contains fewer than 6 characters; the function continues with that character appended to digits.
cases.outcome: Continues with the digit appended to digits.
cases.domain: one of: 0 through 9, with an existing digits length from 0 through 5

cases.name: digit-at-cap
cases.condition: The key is a decimal digit and the gesture's digits already contains 6 characters; the function consumes the keystroke and returns the gesture unchanged.
cases.outcome: Consumes the digit and returns the gesture unchanged.
cases.domain: one of: 0 through 9, with an existing digits length of 6

cases.name: backspace-with-digits
cases.condition: The key is Backspace and digits is non-empty; the function continues with the last character removed.
cases.outcome: Continues with the last character removed from digits.
cases.domain: any non-empty digits string

cases.name: backspace-empty
cases.condition: The key is Backspace and digits is already empty; the function continues with digits still empty and the gesture otherwise unchanged.
cases.outcome: Continues with digits empty and the gesture otherwise unchanged.

cases.name: enter
cases.condition: The key is Enter; the function commits the modal gesture.
cases.outcome: Commits the modal gesture.

cases.name: escape
cases.condition: The key is Escape; the function cancels the modal gesture.
cases.outcome: Cancels the modal gesture.

cases.name: unrecognized-key
cases.condition: The key is any value outside the documented arrows, decimal digits, Backspace, Enter, and Escape; the function ignores it.
cases.outcome: Ignores the key.
cases.domain: any other string

cases.name: no-arguments
cases.condition: The function is called with no arguments; the returned handle includes modalGesture and setModalGesture, with modalGesture initially undefined.
cases.outcome: returns a handle containing modalGesture and setModalGesture, with modalGesture initially undefined.
